name: Radio
usage: Mutually exclusive options such as access level, storage type or visibility

props.name: value
props.description: Value of this option inside a Radio.Group; the same type as the group's value.

members.name: Radio.Group
members.summary:
A group of mutually exclusive options; its value is the value of the selected option. Give the options with
`options`, or as Radio or Radio.Button children; `variant="button"` shows `options` as buttons.

props.name: options
props.description:
The options: plain values (shown as text) or option objects. Instead of `options`, Radio or Radio.Button
elements can be given as children.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the value of the newly selected option.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shows `options` as buttons (like Radio.Button). For switching views, prefer Segmented.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the native radios, for form submission.

props.name: children
props.description: Radio or Radio.Button elements, when `options` is not used.

members.name: Radio.Button
members.summary:
A radio option styled as a button, used as a child of Radio.Group (the same look as `variant="button"`). To
switch between two or three views, prefer Segmented.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of this option inside a Radio.Group; the same type as the group's value.

types.name: ChoiceOption<V>
types.summary: An option of Checkbox.Group, Radio.Group or Segmented.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: For a few mutually exclusive options that are all shown.

examples.name: Buttons
examples.title: Button style
examples.description: `Radio.Button` forms a group of buttons; for switching between two or three views, prefer Segmented.
